'''Tamboon''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Tungra sector/Legends|Tungra sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Once, a [[Cooking droid/Legends|cooking droid]] named [[L9-G8]] prepared a crock of [[Tauntaun chowder]] for the Prince of Tamboon.<ref name="SH">[[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']]</ref>
